sql_query.sql: select "projects"."id", "projects"."name", "projects"."description", "projects"."tags", "projects"."created_at", "projects"."updated_at", "projects"."preview_img_url", "projects"."preview_img_path", "projects"."preview_img_bucket", "projects"."updated_preview_img_at", "projects"."sandbox_id", "projects"."sandbox_url", "projects_userProjects"."data" as "userProjects" from "projects" "projects" left join lateral (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("projects_userProjects"."user_id", "projects_userProjects"."project_id", "projects_userProjects"."created_at", "projects_userProjects"."role")), ?::json) as "data" from "user_projects" "projects_userProjects" where ("projects_userProjects"."project_id" = "projects"."id" and "projects_userProjects"."user_id" = $?)) "projects_userProjects" on ? where "projects"."id" = $? limit $?
